title: A declared screw on the toolpath
rationale: A screw head declared at (1250, 600), 2 mm high, lies on the groove: the tool passes it below its height + 3 mm (safety-model 6.5; C-01). The body hull covers the tool point, so it passes over the screw too (B-OBST), already at the end of the first line (W-FIRST).
